purpose: Question bank for learning, training, and exam simulation

required_fields.question: question text
required_fields.explanation: why the answer is correct and why relevant alternatives are wrong when useful
required_fields.provenance: short statement explaining how the item was derived from the source

quality_rules: Do not copy textbook exercises verbatim; use them as competency blueprints unless a direct quotation is necessary and permitted.
Every item must be traceable to a source section/page.
The answer must be unambiguous from the supplied source/context.
Explanation must teach the underlying concept, not merely state the answer.
Difficulty must reflect cognitive demand, not merely wording length.
Exam-mode items should avoid unnecessary game hints.
